g.text: Needs at least 37 annual values in code.
Seeded AR(1) placebos; no causal claim.
Too-short and POWER-busy paths are explicit.
Cited facts and quiz, not an annual-series test.
Coral spawning is also informational + quiz.
Seas/lakes, mountains/valleys, craters and landing sites are marker layers, not imagery layers.
Ten fixed landmark markers coexist with the gazetteer and do not follow those toggles.
